label: Hardware FP4 dequant
mechanism: grouped NVFP4 GEMM dequant swapped to the Blackwell cvt.rn.f16x2.e2m1x2 hardware convert — bit-identical outputs, 1.21x both kernels
hypothesis: Post-exp-0009 the 61.4 tok/s cycle (133.4 s per 64-seq cohort) is floored on BOTH terms by the SAME two kernels: the exp-0009 profile puts the grouped NVFP4 GEMM at 93% of prefill CUDA (13.5 ms/layer at T=736 after BLOCK_M 32 -> prefill term 75.5 s), and the exp-0005 kernel table puts the same kernels at 179 ms GPU of the B=64 decode step (_gate_up_silu 128.5 + _down_scale 50.9) — the largest GPU block remaining after exp-0007/0008 deleted the attention/sconv storms. Inside these kernels the per-element in-register dequant chain (_e2m1 bit construction: ~10 int-ALU ops + fp32 mul + RTNE, re-run for the full weight tile per (expert, n-tile, k-chunk, m-chunk)) is the floor; exp-0009 reduced the NUMBER of dequant passes, this diff reduces the COST of each: cvt.rn.f16x2.e2m1x2 (PTX 8.6, the CUDA-13 __nv_cvt_fp4x2_to_halfraw2 form) converts both nibbles of a packed byte in ONE hardware instruction via tl.inline_asm_elementwise (pack=1 — pack=4 silently mispacks when a thread owns <4 elements, probe-proven). Because e2m1->f16 and f16->fp32 are exact, the fp32 value*scale mul and RTNE-bf16 round are unchanged, so full-kernel outputs are BITWISE identical to the accepted engine (exp-0008 class): torch.equal TRUE at both launch configs on identical inputs, and the TF gate reproduces exp-0003..0009's output exactly including the disagreements sample. Measured on synthetic checkpoint-shape packs (t_moe_cvt/t_moe_cvt_sweep logs): 1.21x whole-kernel at BOTH operating points — decode-scale T=64 9.99 -> 8.29 ms, prefill-scale T=736 13.5 -> 11.0 ms and T=1018 14.0 -> 11.6 ms at (32,128,128) — best config per scale unchanged, so the exp-0009 dispatch constants stay. Native-FP4 tensor-core MMA (tl.dot_scaled, the bigger rewrite ranked next by exp-0009) was tried FIRST and is dead on Triton 3.6/sm_103a: MLIR assert in TritonGPUAccelerateMatmul for every bf16 x e2m1+e4m3-scale shape (t_ds_probe log) — the remaining floor after this diff is the convert pipe (~2.5 cvt-class ops/element for f16->f32 and RTNE-bf16, inherent to any bit-equal dequant), which only a native-MMA CUDA/CUTLASS port or Triton upgrade can delete.
predicted_delta: +5-12% timeboxed decode_heavy tok/s (61.4 -> ~64.5-69): cycle model 8192/(64 x P1 + decode term) with the measured split 75.5 + 57.9 s; prefill kernels 0.864 s of the in-situ P1 1.18 s (64 layers x 13.5 ms) drop to ~0.71 -> P1 ~1.02, prefill term -> 65.3 s; decode experts 179 -> 148 ms GPU inside the ~0.45 s step -> decode term -> 53.9 s if the GPU segment is exposed (57.9 if enqueue-masked) -> 66.5-68.7 tok/s; floor 64.5 assumes only ~2/3 of the prefill saving nets in situ. prefill_heavy should gain a similar kernel factor on its own row when next measured.
